title: JUAN VIDAL BRIDAL CAMPAIGN
description: Launch campaign for the first bridal collection by Juan Vidal, a Madrid-based brand renowned for its contemporary and feminine vision, born from the collaboration with the Master’s in Styling and Creative Direction at Barreira, Valencia. The project unfolds through studio photography, enriched with collage and mixed-media techniques, exploring new ways of narrating the bridal universe from an artistic perspective.
